content.text: 5. INSTALL SECOND GEAR AND NO. 1 CLUTCH HUB

content.description: Hands holding and installing synchronizer ring onto a gear with needle roller bearing visible

items: (a) Apply gear oil to the shaft and needle roller bearing.
(b) Place the synchronizer ring on the gear and align the ring slots with the shifting keys.
(c) Install the needle roller bearing in the 2nd gear.

content.description: Press installation of 2nd gear and No. 1 clutch hub assembly onto shaft

content.text: (d) Using a press, install the 2nd gear and No. 1 clutch hub.
6. INSTALL LOCKING BALL AND FIRST GEAR ASSEMBLY

content.description: Hand installing locking ball into shaft

items: (a) Install the locking ball in the shaft.
(b) Apply gear oil to the bearing.
(c) Assemble the 1st gear, synchronizer ring, needle roller bearing and bearing inner race.

content.description: Hands holding and aligning first gear assembly with synchronizer ring onto shaft

content.text: (d) Install the assembly on the output shaft with the synchronizer ring slots aligned with the shifting keys and turn the inner race to align it with the locking ball.

content.description: Press installation of center bearing onto output shaft using SST tool

content.text: Using SST and a press, install the bearing on the output shaft with the outer race snap ring groove toward the rear.
NOTE: Hold the 1st gear inner race to prevent it from falling.
